# Reconcile mixed backouts at the level of each changed path

742 backs out a landing that combined MboxCompactor field initialization with Rust path normalization. 743 restores only the two compactor fields. 766 later lands the path work separately and adds normalization of more generated manifest paths. A single backout therefore does not prove that every part of the mixed landing was wrong. The original landing is owned by the adjacent batch at 736. No precise cause of that backout is inferred without its full discussion.

Scope: Mixed landing and reland history.
